# vLLM identity

`vllm-icon.png` is the official vLLM mark from
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/docs/assets/logos/vllm-logo-only-light.png
retrieved September 20, 2026. Used to identify the locally installed framework;
this harness is an independent integration. The Metal backend is part of the vLLM
harness and does not have a separate app identity.
